text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of fifteen thousand pesos, to be expended by the Philippine Exposition Board created by
Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and twenty-four, for the purpose of enabling the Mountain Province and
the Provinces of Nueva Vizcaya and Agusan to make exhibits of their products, industries and resources, at
the Philippine exposition to be held in Manila in the year nineteen hundred and fourteen.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 8, 1913.
